en.title: LYON Punishes Shopify Rebellion, Secures Final LCS Worlds 2026 Slot
en.summary: LYON has clinched the last available spot at the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, ending Shopify Rebellion's impressive lower-bracket surge. The victory secures LYON's place among North America's elite.
en.body:
The dream of a Cinderella run to Worlds for **Shopify Rebellion** has officially been dashed. **LYON** emerged victorious in a decisive 3-1 series win during the LCS Summer Playoffs, securing the final coveted slot at the 2026 League of Legends World Championship. This crucial victory means **LYON** will join **Cloud9** and **Team Liquid** as North America's representatives on the global stage, while **Shopify Rebellion**, despite their valiant effort, will instead compete in the Demacia Cup Global Invitational.

The series saw **LYON** assert dominance early, taking the first two games. Game two, in particular, was a swift and brutal affair, concluding in just 26 minutes with a staggering 23-3 kill score in favor of **LYON**. This early lead seemed insurmountable, but **Shopify Rebellion**, fueled by a standout performance from **Bvoy**, managed to claw back a victory in Game Three, igniting hopes of a reverse sweep. However, any momentum **Shopify** built was extinguished in Game Four. A pivotal 2v2 engagement on the top side of the map faltered for **Shopify Rebellion**, allowing **LYON’s Saint** on Twisted Fate to completely take over the game, leading his team to a decisive 24-8 win and sealing the series.

## A Resilient Run Ends

**Shopify Rebellion's** journey through the lower bracket was nothing short of remarkable. The team consistently defied expectations, battling their way through tough opponents and forcing multiple series to the brink. Their ability to overcome adversity and reach the playoff finals, even if it ultimately ended in fourth place, showcased a significant improvement and a fighting spirit that resonated with fans. This playoff run, culminating in a Demacia Cup invitation, offers a valuable international experience and a chance to prove their mettle against different regions.

## The Road to Worlds Continues

The LCS Summer Playoffs have concluded, and the three teams heading to the 2026 World Championship are now set. **LYON** will undoubtedly be looking to carry this momentum into the biggest tournament of the year. For fans, this means an exciting opportunity to see how **LYON** stacks up against the best League of Legends teams the world has to offer. The anticipation for Worlds 2026 is already building, with North America bringing a formidable, albeit familiar, trio.

content_raw: LYON has secured the LCS’ final spot at the 2026 League of Legends World Championship after beating Shopify Rebellion 3:1 on Sept. 26. The result sends LYON to Worlds alongside Cloud9 and Team Liquid, while Shopify’s unlikely lower-bracket run ends in fourth place and with a spot at the Demacia Cup Global Invitational instead.  LYON took the first two games, including a brutal 23:3 Game Two that lasted just 26 minutes, before Shopify finally answered behind Bvoy in Game Three. Any hopes of another comeback disappeared in the fourth, where LYON finished the series with a 24:8 win as Saint’s Twisted Fate completely took over the game after a failed 2v2 on top.
